title: December Faith at Work Luncheon
seo_title: December Faith at Work Luncheon in Joplin, MO
description: This monthly luncheon brings people together for prayer, networking, growth, and encouragement. It is for local professionals of faith. It takes place Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM at the Crowder College Joplin Advanced Training & Workforce Center, 3405 Hammons Boulevard, Joplin, MO; networking starts at 11:30, the meal and panel run 12:00 to 12:45, and Life Choices sponsors the lunch.
venue: Crowder College Joplin Advanced Training & Workforce Center
